{{Top|leg}}
'''Dhar''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the entry for [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] [[medkit]], Dhar noted that while they were bulkier, they were more effective than a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
